verses.text:
4 "Where were you (Job)
when I (Yahweh) laid the foundations of the earth?
Tell Me, if you have understanding.

5 Who determined its measurements? Surely you know!
Or who stretched the line upon it?

6 To what were its foundations fastened?
Or who laid its cornerstone,

7 When the morning stars sang together,
And all the sons of God shouted for joy?

(These sons of God had to be spiritual beings because nothing physical existed before creation.)

Eph 1:3-6
3 Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing
in the heavenly places,
4 just as He chose us in Him before the foundation of the world,
that we should be holy and without blame before Him in love,
5 having predestined us to adoption as sons
by Jesus Christ to Himself,
according to the good pleasure of His will,
6 to the praise of the glory of His grace,
by which He made us accepted in the Beloved.
Rev 2:7 7 He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To him who overcomes I will give to eat from the tree of life, which is in the midst of the Paradise of God.

Heb 1:13-14
14 Are they not all ministering spirits sent forth to minister for those who will inherit salvation?

14 Are they (angels) not all ministering spirits

<span style="font-size: calc(18px * var(--ew-font, 1));">sent forth to minister

<span style="font-size: calc(18px * var(--ew-font, 1));">for those who will inherit salvation<span style="font-size: calc(18px * var(--ew-font, 1));">?

2 Do you not know that the saints will judge the world?
And if the world will be judged by you,
are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?

3 Do you not know that we shall judge angels?
How much more, things that pertain to this life?

Rom 8:19-21 19 For the earnest expectation of the creation eagerly waits for the revealing of the sons of God. 20 For the creation was subjected to futility, not willingly, but because of Him who subjected it in hope; 21 because the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.
Jhn 3:16 16 For God so loved the world that He gave His only begotten Son, that whoever believes in Him should not perish but have everlasting life.

16 For God so loved the world that He gave His only begotten Son,
that whoever believes in Him
should not perish but have everlasting life.

17 For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world,
but that the world through Him might be saved.

Gen 1:26 26 Then God said,"Let Us make mankind in Our image, according to Our likeness; let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the air, and over the cattle, over all the earth and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth."
Isa 55:11 11 So shall My Word be that goes forth from My mouth; It shall not return to Me void, But it shall accomplish what I please, And it shall prosper in the thing for which I sent it.
